commits.message:
Update GalyPalCalcUi.pyw

Added Features:
Base64 Encoding and Decoding: Implemented functionality to convert the state of the UI components into a Base64 encoded string and vice versa. This facilitates saving and loading the state of the application.
Save and Load Functionality: Added features to save the current state of the application to a file and load it back. This includes handling multiple save slots, saving to and loading from a text file, and managing the names and states associated with each slot.
State String Handling: Incorporated logic to update and apply the state string in the UI, reflecting the changes in sliders, channels, blacklist, and filters.
UI Components for Save Management: Integrated UI elements for managing saves, including entry fields for save names, buttons for saving/loading, and clearing saved states.
Improved Error Handling and Debugging: Enhanced the robustness of the script by adding checks and print statements for debugging purposes.
Modifications:
UI Layout Changes: Adjusted the grid layout in the Tkinter main container to accommodate new elements like save name entry, save/load buttons, and state string display.
LinkedSlider Class Update: Updated the LinkedSlider class to handle changes in channel selection and reflect these changes in the state string.
Recalculation Triggering: Modified the recalculation of results to be conditional, preventing unnecessary recalculations during state string application.
Blacklist Filtering Enhancement: Improved the blacklist filtering logic within the optimization problem, including handling cases where pals are blacklisted.
Utility Functions: Introduced new utility functions like checkBinaryToBytes, clear_state, save_to_file, and load_from_file for various functionalities related to state management.
Bug Fixes and Error Handling:
Handling of Empty State Strings: Added logic to reset the UI to default values when an empty state string is detected.
File I/O Error Handling: Included checks for file existence and content validity when dealing with save files.
State String Integrity Check: Implemented a check to ensure the integrity of the binary to bytes conversion and vice versa.
Code Cleanup and Optimization:
Removal of Redundant Code: Cleaned up duplicate or unnecessary code segments to streamline the script.
Optimization of Data Processing: Refined the data processing logic for efficiency and clarity, especially in the parts handling UI updates and optimization calculations.

Update GalyPalCalcUi.pyw

Refactor Tkinter layout and add dynamic pal filtering

- Transition layout management from pack to grid for main UI.
- Configure weight distribution in the main container for responsive resizing.
- Realign Max Pals, Blacklist, Output Boxes, Skills, and Filter widgets according to the new grid structure.
- Implement immediate application of pal quantity constraints without a separate apply button.
- Add handling for multiple pal constraints, dynamically creating filters on the UI, and updating the LP model.
- Clean up code by removing redundant packings and initializing widgets within grid placements.

Update GalyPalCalcUi.pyw

- Changed the application window title to "GalyPalCalc"

Update GalyPalCalcUi.pyw

- Split the output into two separate windows: one for team composition and one for skill totals.
- Fixed an issue where the outputs were not calculating properly.

Update GalyPalCalcUi.pyw

Added
New UI version of the script, GalyPalCalcUi.pyw, introducing a graphical user interface for enhanced user experience.
Changed
Updated LinkedSlider class to properly handle channel assignment and unassignment.
Modified the on_slider_change function to ensure that sliders affect other sliders only when they are assigned to an active channel.
Fixed
Resolved an issue where sliders continued to influence other sliders in the same channel even after being unassigned from that channel.
